description.fr-FR: Les lettres de Jean Eudes dans les Œuvres complètes (1905–11) : livre I aux prêtres de la Congrégation de Jésus et Marie, livre II aux religieuses de Notre-Dame de Charité, livre III à diverses personnes.
description.en-US: The letters of John Eudes in the Complete Works (1905–11): book I to the priests of the Congregation of Jesus and Mary, book II to the sisters of Our Lady of Charity, book III to various persons.
description.pt-BR: As cartas de João Eudes nas Obras completas (1905–11): livro I aos sacerdotes da Congregação de Jesus e Maria, livro II às religiosas de Nossa Senhora da Caridade, livro III a diversas pessoas.

fr-FR.editor: Charles Lebrun, Ange Le Doré, Joseph Dauphin (Congrégation de Jésus et Marie)

sources.edition: Œuvres complètes du Vénérable Jean Eudes, tome 10, Vannes (Lafolye) et Paris (Beauchesne), 1905–1911, éd. Ch. Lebrun, A. Le Doré, J. Dauphin; transcription Bibliothèque Saint Libère (liberius.net), 2008.
sources.description: Born-digital transcription of the 1905–11 edition, converted by script: page markers and running heads removed, hyphenation and leaked letter-spacing repaired, paragraphs rejoined; the editors’ footnotes are gathered at the end of the file where they fall; footnote call numbers stay in the running text. The editors’ introductions are kept.
sources.tierEvidence: Eudes died in 1680; the 1905–11 edition is public domain.
